verdict.rationale: Solo 2 is a hardware USB/NFC security key that speaks standard device protocols (FIDO2/WebAuthn, OATH, PIV, OpenPGP) and has a local CLI. It is not a web service with an HTTP API, so asking for a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this product type. The 404 probes for openapi.json-style paths are consistent with there being no such API at all.
